notes: Pepes (PEPES) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens to msg.sender once. It has no transfer taxes or administrative powers. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with the specified ERC-20 at a 0.3% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), assuming Pepes is currency0 and the paired token is currency1. The deployer derives the opening price from the supplied economics and totalSupply using the actual currency ordering.
